title: collaea pendula
intro: Collaea pendula, commonly known as the "Queen of the Night" or "Moon Flower," is a type of flowering vine native to Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of Collaea pendula include promoting relaxation, reducing muscle spasms, and acting as a natural anti-inflammatory agent, which can help alleviate symptoms of menopause and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Collaea pendula include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
